messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER (auto) -> Possible cross-tenant KV read detected on dedicated pool dpool-prod-7 (vpc-id: vpc-nebula-9f3b). Runbook: tenant-isolation -> triage. Severity: P1. Please acknowledge and follow runbook.

sally-oncall: Ack — I'm on call. Paging infra + sec. Marco/theo/artemis, can someone confirm if traffic is ongoing and whether we have customer reports?

marco-infra: I'm looking. Observed sustained 500s from dpool-prod-7 starting at 22:03 UTC. Correlating traces show tenant prefix mismatch in KV access. Quick log excerpt:

```
[22:03:12] trace=tx-7b9 get_kv key="prefix:nebula/session:abcd" pool=dpool-prod-7 tenant=nebula
[22:03:13] trace=tx-7b9 get_kv key="prefix:aurora/session:efgh" pool=dpool-prod-7 tenant=nebula
[22:03:13] trace=tx-7bb get_kv key="prefix:nebula/session:xyz" pool=dpool-prod-7 tenant=nebula
```

marco-infra: Looks like a routing prefix shadowing/misroute — the request metadata shows tenant=nebula but key owner is aurora.

theo-runtime: That pattern matches a router rule regression we rolled out in rev 1271. Starting immediate mitigations: 1) snapshot caches + routing config; 2) put routers in read-only mode for the pool; 3) rollback router to last known good rev. Will coordinate.

lina-support: Nebula support thread: cust tech lead messaged "brief latency spike, a few 500s, no visible data anomalies on our side yet" — they're in the loop. Creating private channel with CSM now.

artemis-sec: Hold evictions until we snapshot. Need full trace dumps, routing table, and KV ownership table for forensic. Also capturing timestamps for any potentially mismatched accesses. Initial telemetry shows ~40 cross-tenant accesses in the 5m window.

sally-oncall: Plan (short):
1) Marco -> run snapshot of KV cache + router config for dpool-prod-7
2) Theo -> enable read-only routing on nodes serving dpool-prod-7, prevent writes/evictions that could discard evidence
3) Artemis -> collect traces + run quick SQL to quantify mismatches
4) Lina -> notify Nebula CSM/tech lead and legal pre-notify (we may need disclosure)
Please acknowledge and report back with timestamps.

marco-infra: Running snapshot script now: `/opt/ops/snap_kv.sh --pool dpool-prod-7 --outfile /tmp/snap-3141592653.tar.gz`
marco-infra: Snapshot complete -> /tmp/snap-3141592653.tar.gz (1.2GB). SHA256: 3b7f...f4a

theo-runtime: Executing read-only routing toggle on nodes {node7,node8,node9}. Command: 
```
for node in node7 node8 node9; do ssh $node 'sudo systemctl set-environment ROUTER_MODE=readonly && sudo systemctl restart redwood-router'; done
```
theo-runtime: Routers restarted in readonly mode for pool dpool-prod-7. Observing traffic now.

incident-bot: Status update -> mitigations executing (snapshot taken, routers readonly).

lina-support: Nebula notified via email + private slack channel. Sample to CSM: "We're investigating an internal routing issue that may have caused cross-tenant KV reads on a dedicated pool. We're containing and auditing; we'll follow up with confirmed impact within 2 hours."

artemis-sec: Running quick query against access logs to count mismatches: 
```
SELECT count(*) FROM kv_access WHERE tenant_read <> tenant_owner AND ts >= now() - interval '5 minutes';
-- result: 42
```
artemis-sec: Confirmed 42 mismatched reads in the window. Collecting full access list and trace ids now.

sally-oncall: 42 confirmed. Isolate and next: determine if any sensitive keys read. Artemis, please prioritize keys with patterns matching PII (email, ssn, token).

artemis-sec: Doing pattern scan on keys from dump. Preliminary: 0 hits for ssn/token patterns, 3 hits for email-like keys (likely customer metadata). Fetching payload samples for manual review — using sanitized copies.

theo-runtime: Root cause identified in router config merge: rule precedence change in rev 1271 caused wildcard prefix to shadow tenant-specific routes under heavy connection churn. Rolling back router to rev 1269 for pool dpool-prod-7.
theo-runtime: Rollback command: `deploy-router --pool dpool-prod-7 --rollback-to 1269 --drain=false` (started).

marco-infra: Rollback initiated, monitoring health. After rollback, will perform controlled cache flush to remove any invalid mappings.

incident-bot: Postmortem task created -> INC-3141592653 (owners: eng-runtime, eng-infra, security, support)

lina-support: Nebula update: "Thanks for the quick action. We'll await confirmed analysis. No customer complaints yet beyond short latency."

artemis-sec: Post-rollback quick check: cross-tenant read count in next 5m window = 0. Exporting logs and preparing evidence bag for legal/compliance. Suggest rotating any credentials that could have been exposed as a precaution.

sally-oncall: Status -> mitigated. Rollback complete, traffic normalized, cross-tenant reads dropped to 0. Leaving incident open for full audit and customer follow-up. Action items assigned:
- Theo (eng-runtime): full audit of router rollout pipeline + fix gating tests + canary improvements
- Marco (eng-infra): add snapshot hook to deployment pipeline for dedicated pools
- Artemis (security): complete forensic review, advise on disclosure and credential rotations
- Lina (support): coordinate customer comms and post-incident summary

sally-oncall: Closing pager. Thanks team for quick coordination. :white_check_mark:

artemis-sec: Note for follow-up: propose mandatory pre-rollout isolation test that simulates connection churn and verifies prefix precedence under load. Also propose adding metric alert for tenant_owner != tenant_read > 0.

marco-infra: I'll open infra task to add snapshot hook and alerting.

theo-runtime: Will prepare PR for rollback mitigations and add canary gating.

lina-support: Preparing draft for Nebula: will include timeline, number of mismatches (42), mitigation steps, and planned next steps.

incident-bot: Thread closed for paging; incident record remains open for follow-up.
